name: Dolo 650 Tablet
indication: Used for temporary relief of mild to moderate pain (such as headache, body pain, toothache, muscle ache) and reduction of fever.
basicInformation: Paracetamol 650mg works by inhibiting the production of prostaglandins in the central nervous system and resetting the temperature-regulating center in the brain. It is an over-the-counter medication widely used in India.

name: Paracetamol 500mg Tablet
indication: Used for lowering body temperature during fever and alleviating mild pains including headache, joint soreness, and viral fever discomfort.
basicInformation: An essential antipyretic medicine that blocks cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes in the brain. It provides gentle relief from elevated body temperatures and routine pains.

name: Metformin 500mg Tablet
indication: Used for management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus to help lower elevated blood glucose levels alongside diet and physical activity.
basicInformation: Metformin reduces hepatic glucose production in the liver, decreases intestinal absorption of glucose, and improves insulin sensitivity in peripheral tissues without causing hypoglycemia on its own.

name: Telmisartan 40mg Tablet
indication: Used for the management of essential hypertension (high blood pressure) and to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events such as stroke and heart attack.
basicInformation: Telmisartan blocks the binding of angiotensin II to AT1 receptors in vascular smooth muscle, causing blood vessels to relax and dilate, effectively lowering blood pressure.

name: Pantoprazole 40mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), heartburn, acid indigestion, gastritis, and peptic ulcers.
basicInformation: Pantoprazole suppresses gastric acid secretion by specifically inhibiting the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme system at the secretory surface of the gastric parietal cells.

name: Atorvastatin 10mg Tablet
indication: Used for lowering high LDL ('bad') cholesterol and triglycerides in the blood, and reducing the risk of heart disease, angina, and arterial plaque buildup.
basicInformation: Atorvastatin selectively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme that converts HMG-CoA to mevalonate, a precursor of cholesterol.

name: Amlodipine 5mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating hypertension (high blood pressure) and chronic stable angina (chest pain).
basicInformation: Amlodipine inhibits transmembrane influx of calcium ions into cardiac and vascular smooth muscle, promoting systemic arterial vasodilation and reducing vascular resistance.

name: Cetirizine 10mg Tablet
indication: Used for relieving allergic symptoms including sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, itching, hives, and allergic skin rashes.
basicInformation: Cetirizine is a potent, selective peripheral H1 receptor antagonist that prevents histamine from triggering allergic cascade responses.

name: Azithromycin 500mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating susceptible bacterial infections such as throat infections (pharyngitis, tonsillitis), sinusitis, bronchitis, pneumonia, and certain skin infections.
basicInformation: Azithromycin binds to the 50S ribosomal subunit of susceptible microorganisms, interfering with microbial protein synthesis.

name: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid 625mg Tablet
indication: Used for bacterial infections of the respiratory tract, ear, nose, throat, urinary tract, skin, and dental tissues resistant to amoxicillin alone.
basicInformation: Amoxicillin inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis while clavulanic acid inhibits beta-lactamase enzymes produced by resistant bacteria.

name: Montelukast + Levocetirizine Tablet
manufacturer: Cipla Ltd / Lupin Ltd / Sun Pharma
therapeuticClass: Respiratory & Antiallergic Combination (Leukotriene Receptor Antagonist + Antihistamine)
indication: Used for the management of allergic rhinitis, persistent sneezing, allergic asthma symptoms, and chronic seasonal allergies.
basicInformation: Montelukast blocks cysteinyl leukotriene receptors to reduce airway inflammation, while Levocetirizine provides selective peripheral H1 blockade.

name: Combiflam Tablet
indication: Used for short-term symptomatic relief of muscular pain, joint pain, toothache, inflammation, dysmenorrhea, and fever.
basicInformation: Combines Ibuprofen (an NSAID that reduces inflammatory prostaglandins by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2) with Paracetamol (acting centrally to raise pain threshold).

name: Omeprazole 20mg Capsule
indication: Used for treatment of acid reflux, heartburn, duodenal and gastric ulcers, and prevention of NSAID-induced ulcers.
basicInformation: Omeprazole binds irreversibly to the gastric proton pump (H+/K+-ATPase), effectively shutting down acid production in the stomach lining.

name: Rabeprazole 20mg Tablet
indication: Used for rapid symptom relief in erosive gastroesophageal reflux disease, non-ulcer dyspepsia, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
basicInformation: Rabeprazole provides faster initial acid suppression compared to some earlier generation PPIs by rapid covalent binding to proton pumps.

name: Ciprofloxacin 500mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating bacterial urinary tract infections, severe diarrhea due to bacterial enteritis, bone and joint infections, and skin infections.
basicInformation: Ciprofloxacin inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV, essential enzymes for bacterial DNA replication, transcription, and repair.

name: Ofloxacin 200mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating pelvic inflammatory diseases, bacterial gastroenteritis, urinary infections, and respiratory infections.
basicInformation: Ofloxacin prevents bacterial cell division by inhibiting bacterial type II topoisomerases.

name: Metoprolol Succinate 25mg Tablet
indication: Used for managing hypertension, angina pectoris, stable heart failure, and preventing recurrent myocardial infarction.
basicInformation: Selectively blocks beta-1 receptors in the heart, reducing heart rate, cardiac output, and systemic blood pressure.

name: Losartan 50mg Tablet
indication: Used for high blood pressure control, renal protection in type 2 diabetic patients with proteinuria, and reducing stroke risk in patients with left ventricular hypertrophy.
basicInformation: Blocks vasoconstrictor and aldosterone-secreting effects of angiotensin II by selectively binding to AT1 receptors.

name: Clopidogrel 75mg Tablet
indication: Used for preventing atherothrombotic events (blood clots) in patients with prior stroke, heart attack, or following stent placement.
basicInformation: Irreversibly inhibits the binding of adenosine diphosphate (ADP) to its platelet P2Y12 receptor, preventing platelet aggregation.

name: Glimepiride 1mg Tablet
indication: Used for lowering blood glucose in type 2 diabetes mellitus when diet and exercise alone are insufficient.
basicInformation: Stimulates insulin release from functioning pancreatic beta cells by closing ATP-sensitive potassium channels.

name: Dapagliflozin 10mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating type 2 diabetes mellitus, heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, and chronic kidney disease.
basicInformation: Inhibits sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) in the proximal renal tubules, reducing reabsorption of filtered glucose and promoting its excretion in urine.

name: Ondansetron 4mg Tablet
indication: Used for prevention and management of nausea and vomiting induced by gastroenteritis, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or surgery.
basicInformation: Selectively antagonizes serotonin 5-HT3 receptors located centrally in the chemoreceptor trigger zone and peripherally on vagal nerve terminals in the gut.

name: Domperidone 10mg Tablet
indication: Used for relief of nausea, vomiting, epigastric fullness, and delayed gastric emptying (gastroparesis).
basicInformation: Acts as a peripheral dopamine receptor antagonist in the gastrointestinal tract and chemoreceptor trigger zone, increasing gastrointestinal motility.

name: Rosuvastatin 10mg Tablet
indication: Used for management of dyslipidemia, lowering LDL cholesterol and apolipoprotein B, and slowing the progression of atherosclerosis.
basicInformation: Competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase in liver hepatocytes, increasing hepatic LDL cell-surface receptors to clear circulating LDL.

name: Salbutamol (Albuterol) Inhaler / Tablet
indication: Used for rapid relief of acute bronchospasm, wheezing, and shortness of breath in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
basicInformation: Stimulates beta-2 receptors on bronchial smooth muscle, triggering relaxation and rapid dilation of the respiratory airways.

name: Budesonide Respules / Inhaler
indication: Used for maintenance therapy and long-term prophylactic management of bronchial asthma and airway inflammation.
basicInformation: Exerts local anti-inflammatory action in pulmonary airways, reducing bronchial hyperresponsiveness and mucosal swelling.

name: Diclofenac 50mg Tablet
indication: Used for treating acute pain, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sprains, musculoskeletal injuries, and post-operative dental pain.
basicInformation: Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX-1 and COX-2) enzymes, halting the peripheral production of inflammatory prostaglandins.

name: Doxycycline 100mg Capsule
indication: Used for treating acne vulgaris, respiratory bacterial infections, chlamydia, rickettsial diseases (scrub typhus), and malaria prophylaxis.
basicInformation: Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by reversibly binding to the 30S ribosomal subunit.

name: Fluconazole 150mg Tablet
indication: Used for fungal infections including vaginal candidiasis, oral thrush, esophageal candidiasis, and dermatophyte infections.
basicInformation: Inhibits fungal cytochrome P-450 dependent enzyme lanosterol 14-alpha-demethylase, halting fungal cell membrane ergosterol synthesis.

name: Mupirocin 2% Ointment
indication: Used for topical treatment of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, folliculitis, and minor infected cuts/scrapes.
basicInformation: Reversibly binds to bacterial isoleucyl transfer-RNA synthetase, stopping bacterial protein synthesis in Gram-positive bacteria.

name: Loperamide 2mg Capsule
indication: Used for symptomatic control of acute non-specific diarrhea and chronic diarrhea associated with inflammatory bowel conditions.
basicInformation: Slows intestinal transit by stimulating mu-opioid receptors in the circular muscle layer of the gut, reducing stool frequency.

name: Lactulose Solution
indication: Used for treatment of chronic constipation and prevention/treatment of portal systemic encephalopathy.
basicInformation: A synthetic disaccharide broken down by colonic bacteria into low molecular weight organic acids, drawing water into the stool lumen.

name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol) 60,000 IU
indication: Used for treatment and prevention of Vitamin D deficiency, supporting bone mineralization, calcium absorption, and immune function.
basicInformation: Converted in the liver to calcifediol and then in the kidneys to calcitriol, which enhances dietary calcium and phosphorus intestinal absorption.

name: Calcium with Vitamin D3 Tablet
indication: Used for management of osteoporosis, osteomalacia, post-menopausal bone health, and dietary calcium deficiency.
basicInformation: Replenishes essential elemental calcium required for neuromuscular function and skeletal bone density.

name: B-Complex with Zinc Capsule
genericName: B-Complex Vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B12, Folic Acid) + Zinc
indication: Used for nutritional replenishment during fatigue, mouth ulcers, antibiotic therapy recovery, and metabolic energy maintenance.
basicInformation: Water-soluble B-complex vitamins act as essential coenzymes in cellular metabolism and tissue repair, while zinc supports wound healing.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) Sachet
genericName: Sodium Chloride + Potassium Chloride + Sodium Citrate + Dextrose
indication: Used for prevention and treatment of dehydration and electrolyte loss caused by acute diarrhea, vomiting, fever, or excessive heat perspiration.
basicInformation: WHO-recommended oral rehydration formulation leveraging sodium-glucose co-transport in the small intestine to restore fluid balance rapidly.

name: Ferrous Ascorbate + Folic Acid Tablet
indication: Used for prevention and treatment of iron deficiency anemia and nutritional anemia during pregnancy, lactation, and post-illness.
basicInformation: Ferrous ascorbate provides bioavailable elemental iron for hemoglobin synthesis in erythrocytes, and folic acid supports cell division.

name: Levothyroxine 50mcg Tablet
indication: Used for replacement therapy in hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid gland) and pituitary TSH suppression.
basicInformation: Synthetic levo-isomer of thyroxine (T4) that is deiodinated in peripheral tissues to triiodothyronine (T3) to regulate basal metabolic rate.

name: Human Insulin (30/70 Regular + NPH) Injection
indication: Used for glycemic control in Type 1 Diabetes and advanced Type 2 Diabetes requiring exogenous insulin therapy.
basicInformation: Facilitates cellular uptake of glucose in muscle and adipose tissues and halts hepatic glucose production.

name: Ceftriaxone 1g Injection
indication: Used in clinical and hospital settings for severe bacterial infections including bacterial meningitis, septicemia, abdominal infections, and pneumonia.
basicInformation: Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis by binding to one or more penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs).
